scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,api,worker -c blue,green,yellow "pnpm --filter boss-web dev" "PYTHONPATH=.:engine ${PYTHON_BIN:-./.venv/bin/python} -m apps.api.serve --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload" "PYTHONPATH=.:engine ${PYTHON_BIN:-./.venv/bin/python} -m apps.worker.boss_worker.main"
scripts.test: pnpm --filter boss-web test && PYTHONPATH=.:engine ${PYTHON_BIN:-./.venv/bin/python} -m pytest --rootdir=. apps/api/tests apps/worker/tests engine/tests tests/e2e/selftest
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter boss-web lint && ${PYTHON_BIN:-./.venv/bin/python} -m ruff check apps/api apps/worker
